item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 31/Dec/2021
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will bring generally fine weather to the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. The weather will remain cool in the morning over the region. Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it is expected to be cloudier with a few rain patches over Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week.

Date/Month: 01/01 (Saturday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Cloudy at first. Mainly fine and dry during the day.
Temp range: 17 - 21 C
R.H. range: 60 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
